item.title: discourse: 2026.8.0 -> 2026.9.0
item.description:
https://releases.discourse.org/changelog/v2026.9.0/

Fixes:

  • CVE-2026-91159 Stored oEmbed HTML injection via allowed iframe
  • CVE-2026-91157 Media uploads remain publicly accessible after category permissions are restricted
  • CVE-2026-91156 Chat MessageBus delivers read-restricted messages to unauthorized users

The only annoying bit was the voice plugin asset symlink. It wants to create that on every discourse-rake call, so even for the mail receiver plugin, so I create that symlink at build time now. Not a fan of the implementation, open to discuss alternatives.

https://github.com/discourse/discourse/blob/343b20f97ef5f6bd70826ee0e993ba348b210fd5/plugins/voice/plugin.rb#L11-L29

item.title: [Backport release-26.05] technitium-dns-server: 15.4.0 -> 15.5.1
item.description:
Manual backport of #567216 to release-26.05. The automatic backport reported a cherry-pick failure; git cherry-pick -x a29dbc255c9c0d3c825689a849f926665053ca61 onto the current release-26.05 (cf5e76507c6e) applies cleanly, and the diff is identical to the commit on master.

Why: in a three-node Technitium cluster, a NixOS 26.05 node on 15.4.0 cannot sync cluster configuration with peers already on 15.5.x. The maintainer added the backport label on #567216.

Changelog: https://github.com/TechnitiumSoftware/DnsServer/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md

item.title: php84: 8.4.25 -> 8.4.26
item.description:
Update php84 from 8.4.25 to 8.4.26, the September 24 security release. Only the version and source hash change.

Release notes.

Validation on x86_64-linux, with Nix sandboxing enabled, at eb2d9129bd9784275fb4dd1734ce3c6f329d8079:

  • Package build passed.
  • All five existing package tests passed with the suite explicitly instantiated using php84.
  • All four php84.tests.nixos tests passed: FPM/nginx, modular FPM, Apache, and PCRE JIT.
  • CLI, phpdbg, and CGI request checks passed for JSON, SQLite, PCRE, and the FILTER_SANITIZE_ENCODED 0xFF regression. CGI/FPM version checks passed. PHAR and PEAR utilities were not functionally tested.

nixpkgs-review 4.0.0 against upstream master at 67a8379458e5772782cc545af1032202d0b731cb: 187 built, 1 failed, 4 attributes already marked broken, and 2 tests excluded by the review tool. The broken attributes are the default and versioned aliases for Couchbase and parallel. The excluded tests are tests.php.overrideAttrs-preserves-enabled-extensions and tests.php.withExtensions-enables-previously-disabled-extensions; both passed in the explicitly instantiated five-test PHP 8.4 suite above. Full generated report is posted separately.

phpExtensions.event (php84Extensions.event) also fails on unchanged upstream 67a8379458e5772782cc545af1032202d0b731cb (PHP 8.4.25) with the same bufferevent_openssl_get_ssl not found in event_openssl library configure error. Reproduced there with nix-build -A php84Extensions.event --no-out-link; this failure predates the update.

Reproduction:

nix-build -A php84 --no-out-link
nix-build --no-out-link --expr 'let pkgs = import ./. {}; in pkgs.callPackage ./pkgs/test/php { php = pkgs.php84; }'
nix-build -A php84.tests.nixos --no-out-link
nix-shell -p nixpkgs-review --run 'nixpkgs-review rev HEAD --no-shell --print-result --remote upstream --branch master --num-eval-workers 1 --max-memory-size 4096'
